description: Quote the exact Gold price to edit an owned image using a text instruction. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_edit_image_prompt_edit with the same inputs and quote_token.

image_id.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery. Creates a new image.

instruction.description: Describe only the change to make, and what to keep the same.

model.description: Optional model for this edit; omitted uses the default.

quality.description: Quality, where supported; higher quality can cost more.
